item.title: Majority of London’s Thames Bridges Are in Poor Condition
item.description: Over half of London’s bridges across the River Thames are in ‘poor’ or ‘very poor’ condition, the worst possible ratings, with the crossing in Chelsea deteriorating after heavy vehicles were recently diverted from a nearby crossing.

item.description: Jonathan Ferro, Lisa Abramowicz and Annmarie Hordern speak daily with leaders and decision makers from Wall Street to Washington and beyond. No other program better positions investors and executives for the trading day than "Bloomberg Surveillance." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Chile Pension Funds Breath Sigh of Relief as Swap Losses Narrow
item.description: Chilean pension funds saw returns rebound in October as a drop in US yields narrowed losses on massive interest-rate swap positions that have sparked anger from politicians and undermined faith in the system among savers.

item.title: US, Venezuela in Talks on Fresh Aluminum Cargo in Trade Revival
item.description: Venezuela is in negotiations for a second shipment of aluminum to the US as part of a symbolic resumption of trade after years of economic and diplomatic disruptions.

item.title: Midterm Election Trading on Kalshi and Polymarket Lags Prediction Market Boom
item.description: The US presidential election in 2024 served as a big-bang moment for prediction markets. Two years later, their forecasts on the 2026 midterms are getting plenty of attention, but the underlying trading illustrates how the platforms have struggled to expand beyond a few booming categories.
